notes.title: Game update and special 20% OFF sale!
notes.notes:
[h2]Good news, Adepts of Alchemical Arts![/h2]

[b]Alchemist Shop Simulator[/b] has just received an update introducing a lot of quality-of-live improvements and fixes. You can check the entire changelog for ver. 1.03 below, but before that let please give us a moment to thank all the players who have contacted us [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3043310]here on Steam[/url], or [url=https://discord.gg/VvjT3Kndgx]via our Discord[/url], to tell us what they think about the game and their ideas on how to improve it. We appreciate so many of you taking their time to reach out to us! You're the best.

We're happy to see so many of you enjoying our first retail sim game! Please consider letting the other Steam Players that you like it via the awesome power granted to you by Steam - that is, by leaving a review :) This is the best way to help us with sales and ensure the continued development on the game. Or should we say... games? Scroll down below the changelog to find out what we mean!

[h2]Special promo - save 20% on Alchemist Shop Simulator![/h2]

Yes, we do have a special discount to go with the update! Until 2nd June, 10am PST you can get the game with 20% discount, which brings the price just under $10 for the very first time.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3043310/Alchemist_Shop_Simulator/

[h2]Full 1.03 Cahngelog:[/h2]
[b]Changes:[/b][list]
[*] In cursor mode (accessible via [TAB], a button was added that allows you to teleport to the shop (by a teleportation rune the player now carries).
[*] Plant labels are now smaller, so they don’t obscure other labels as much.
[*] Customers now pay slightly smaller amounts, resulting in less change being returned.
[*] It’s now possible to sell shelves and flowerpots. Just aim at them and press R to open a popup. If a pot contains a plant or a piece of furniture holds items, it cannot be sold—a popup explains why. These items sell for half their original value.
[*] Going to sleep now progresses the growth/wilting of plants. It’s a fairly complex system that also takes into account upgrades (such as the cloud that waters plants).
[*] A vertical scrollbar has been added to the skills screen, allowing navigation on wider screen resolutions. All resolutions should be playable now - if there's still any trouble, please let us know!
[*] Pressing ESC while using the alchemy table no longer opens the pause menu, but instead causes the player to stop using the table.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b][list]
[*] It’s no longer possible to take an item out of a chest when its quantity is set to 0. (sorry folks!)
[*] Fixed a bug where it was possible to spend 2 skill points on the same skill by clicking the button before the animation finished. This should prevent players from being able to complete the skill tree.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the mailbox icon to not always appear when a new letter arrived.
[/list]

[h2]Pirate Cove Simulator - play the demo of our next game![/h2]
[previewyoutube=GAnbiFXDdA8;full][/previewyoutube]

There you have it, matey. The long-awaited demo to the second of our retail sims is now out for every landlubber and salty dog to try out for themselves. The game shares some ideas of the Alchemist Shop Simulator, but comes with a lot of original takes and new mechanics, so make sure to check the demo out. And while you're there - don't forget to hit those [b]wishlist[/b] and [b]follow[/b] buttons, so we can keep you in the loop in the (short) time leading to the game's full release.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3290660/Pirate_Cove_Simulator/

This is it for today, from your friends at Kool2Play. Stir your cauldrons well, Adepts!
[h2]Best wishes,[/h2]
[h3]Kool2Play Team[/h3]

notes.title: Release Date & Next Fest Demo update!
notes.notes:
[h2]Scholars![/h2]
We're happy to announce that the development of our magical and cozy retail management sim, [b]Alchemist Shop Simulator[/b], has come to a conclusion and there's only a bit over 2 weeks of wait before the FULL release (that's right - no Early Access).

[previewyoutube=E77s6jI1Wdk;full][/previewyoutube]

We aimed to expand and improve on the popular concept of shop management games by giving it some more immersive mechanics (like potion brewing, gardening, little story-quests) and a vibrant, funny, fantastical world. We'd love to hear from you - did we succeed?

For the last several months lots of Steam players tried the demo (currently enjoying 100% positive rating!) and provided us with feedback. Some content creators who already got their hands on on the full game preview copies have been in touch with us as well. Thanks to all the amazing people who played the game and took their time to give us their thoughts we've been able to improve on the initial state of the game immensely. We'll be launching a far superior game to what we originally had in mind - all thanks to the wonderful community of Steam players. 

This also called for...

[h1]Next Fest Demo update![/h1]

The [b]Alchemist Shop Simulator Demo[/b] has undergone an extensive revamp as well. What everyone will play now, at Steam Next Fest is fully representative of the current state of the full game, so you can have a real taste of the alchemist's world and life in magical retail. Just mind the fact that the demo will be going away soon after the Next Fest ends (but probably not immediately).

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3043310/Alchemist_Shop_Simulator/

Please enjoy the demo and remember to wishlist the full game, so we can remind you when it launches. This will additionally benefit you because we do plan to run a release-week discount for the game (which will be regularly priced at $11.99). 

[h1]More retail sims incoming![/h1]

Upon completion of our [b]Alchemist Shop Simulator[/b], Kool2Play now puts its focus on its tropical follow up - [b]Pirate Cove Simulator[/b]. No worries - this doesn't mean we're not planning on updating Alchemist Shop Simulator. On the contrary - we look forward to all the post-release feedback, as it will give us opportunity to improve and expand BOTH of the games.

[b]Pirate Cove Simulator [/b] will be getting its own demo soon - no later than April - when we're satisfied that it includes everything we've learned during and soon after the launch of its predecessor.

If you do enjoy retail sims, and would like to take a shot at breaking the curse of the Island of the Damned, and trading your way out of the pirate afterlife - you can already wishlist Pirate Cove Simulator:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3290660/Pirate_Cove_Simulator/

That's it from us today! We hope you'll enjoy the Alchemist Shop Simulator demo and join us for its FULL LAUNCH on March 11. 

Get brewing!

Yours,
[h3]Kool2Play Team[/h3]

notes.title: BIG Demo update!
notes.notes:
[h3]Adepts of the arcane arts![/h3]

When we first released our demo, [b]Alchemist Shop Simulator[/b] was still early in the development. Now, as the game is more or less done, and we're focusing on giving it some final polishing touches, we couldn't bare the thought that the demo players are experiencing an outdated version of our game. Time to change this! Today, we're rolling out [b]Demo v. 1.0.1[/b], with all the bells and whistles of the full game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074735/77a833f119384f962eeca87d09e2df2d839c8a78.jpg[/img]

[h2]Release notes for Demo v. 1.0.1:[/h2]
[list]
[*] There's a save and load function now, along with three save-slots to have more than one game going at once
[*] The town came to life with NPCs going about their business or just idling like... well... like NPCs
[*] A lot of Quality-of-Life improvements were introduced to the game, like pinning potion recipes in the grimoire so that they will levitate above the alchemy station, quick search bar for items in storages and store, and many others
[*] Display with aspect ratios other than 16:9 are now better supported
[*] The missing Korean localization was added
[*] A settings menu was added
[*] Lots of bugs were fixed[/list]

But don't just read about it - please, try it for yourself! And do remember to wishlist the full game if you enjoy the demo. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3114000/Alchemist_Shop_Simulator_Demo/

On that note, if you do like your experience with our demo, it would mean a lot to our team, if you share a review of the demo (yes, you can now review demos!) with the rest of the Steam community. 

[h3]That's it for today. May your cauldron never leak![/h3]

[h2]Kool2Play Team[/h2]

notes.title: Alchemist Shop Simulator DEMO to be released at the Wholesome Games Celebration
notes.notes:
[h1]Adepts! Prepare your cauldrons![/h1]

We're happy to announce that [b]Alchemy Shop Simulator[/b] will be getting a [b]DEMO[/b], and we already have a launch date for it. To make things even nicer, that said date isn't that far off. In fact, it's only 2 weeks from now! You'll get to set up your magical business as soon as [b]August 15, 2024.[/b]

Make sure to [b]add the game to your wishlist[/b], as Steam now is kind enough to inform you that a demo has launched for a game, that you've wishlisted. This way you'll make sure you won't miss it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3043310/Alchemist_Shop_Simulator

[h2]Wholesome Games Steam Celebration[/h2]

[b]Wholesome Games[/b] is a community that started on Twitter when indie game developer Matthew Taylor began curating games according to their feelings of comfort, compassion, and coziness. As the official website states:
[quote]"[i]One of the goals of Wholesome Games is to change how we think about which games are taken seriously. For many years, the most critically acclaimed titles have been the ones with the darkest themes and grimmest depictions of life, but there's also a whole world of hopeful video games with rich storytelling, innovative gameplay, and beautiful art and sound. We want to be a part of showcasing the breadth of experiences that games can have for players.[/i]"[/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074735/4dad857413119596ffc28fc59fef396abfbc2d61.png[/img]
We are honored to announce, that this summer our [b]Alchemist Shop Simulator[/b] has been invited to participate in the Wholesome Games Steam Celebration event, that will start on Thursday, August 15th, at 1pm ET (that's 10AM PST, 7PM CET, and 2AM on Friday in Tokyo!). Make sure to drop by - not just for our Demo, but also for dozens of other awesome games, many of them with nice discounts!

[b]See you soon! Yours truly,[/b]
[h2]Kool2Play Team[/h2]

notes.title: Announcing Alchemist Shop Simulator
notes.notes:
[h1]Welcome, adepts of arcane arts![/h1]

We're excited to announce [b]Alchemist Shop Simulator[/b], a game about running a magic shop and brewing potions, that we're working on here, at Kool2Play. We take the proven, super-fun and addictive retail management gameplay and put our very own spin on it, infusing it with potion crafting, comedy, and quirky clients. If you enjoy titles such as Supermarket Simulator and Potion Craft, our game is right up your alley!

[previewyoutube=Cpishh44c0I;full][/previewyoutube]

The game is still in development - here's what to expect in the upcoming months:
[list]
[*] A closed playtest of the beta version, where we'll be looking for your feedback
[*] A public demo of the game with most of the features, but limited content
[*] A full release, with no Early Access stage - we plan to launch the complete game, and support it with updates based on your feedback
[/list]

We're here to answer all your questions here, on Steam, but you are very welcome to join our official [b]Discord Server[/b] and chat with us there, too! Joining us there will also be the easiest way of getting into the beta-tests. We're looking forward to hearing from you!

Please add the game to your [b]Steam Wishlist[/b] and follow it on Steam for more news!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3043310/Alchemist_Shop_Simulator/

[h2]Get ready to brew your legacy as the ultimate alchemist shopkeeper![/h2]

[i][b]See you later, Adepts!
Yours, Kool2Play[/b][/i]
